name: tracker-cli-compat
goal: Prove the five priority legacy CLI surfaces using isolated native fixtures while preserving read-only inspections and legacy output and command exits.

evidence: Compared legacy 7acf3ca command switches, output formatters, and daemon routes to f7aa66cce4 native CLI and API.

The existing TrackerCommand suite covered only the retained-client fence and run/model request parsing. Extend the suite with native command-to-dispatcher fixtures for the five missing command capabilities.
